title: Invasion of Martinique (1674)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Invasion of Martinique (1674)", at revision 1382431795, opens: "The invasion of Martinique in 1674 was an unsuccessful attempt by the Dutch Republic to conquer the Caribbean island of Martinique from France. In spite of overwhelming Dutch superiority in men and ships, the French won a decisive and unexpected victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18216969, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1674 unsuccessful Dutch invasion of the island during the Franco-Dutch War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (from Q142, the country the item names): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
